revisions.title: The closing call: practice justice and follow this account
revisions.body: The closing call turns the surviving account into a way of life. Socrates urges Callicles to follow it by practicing justice and the rest of virtue in living and dying. He says rhetoric should always point toward what is just, then invites others to follow this path rather than the one Callicles trusts.
